core.title: Compose design-system primitives for interactive controls in app code
core.given: Application code outside the design-system root that renders user-facing markup: component source, or markup embedded in string literals of source files (the profile's markup kinds).
core.then: Render it through a design-system primitive, never a raw interactive control element (the profile's interactive-controls list).
prefer: Use the existing primitive; pass the required attributes through it.
During GREEN: reuse the primitive that already represents the control.
During GREEN: extend only the smallest property or attribute surface the current interaction requires.
During GREEN: create a new primitive only if none represents the control correctly.
avoid: Raw interactive markup bypassing the primitive just to pass the acceptance.
Generic primitive parameters the current behavior does not need.
unless: No design-system root in the repository (nothing to connect to yet; not judged).
Test files (per the profile's test-file patterns) and vendored/build trees (never scanned).
Static markup files of the profile's markup file kinds (suffix.markup): markup file kinds outside the judged markup kinds (idiom.markup_kinds), which cannot consume components.
core.why: Controls hold focus, disabled, error and loading states; each raw control re-implements them and diverges. Primitives keep controls themed, accessible, consistent.
evidence: The stack's raw-control check reports no findings in markup-bearing code outside the design-system root.
Prove: the rendered interactive control comes through the design-system primitive.
verification: Scope: the check flags raw interactive controls (the profile's interactive-controls list) written in markup-bearing application code — component source and string-embedded markup (the profile's markup kinds) — outside the design-system root.
Self-scoping: a repository with no design-system root is not judged; there is no system to connect to yet.

Only literal markup text is judged where markup is embedded in code: code positions (comparisons, type assertions), comments, and regex literals are never treated as markup, and a control spanning an interpolation is read on its literal chunks alone.

Never scanned: test files (the profile's test-file patterns), vendored/build trees (never scanned stack-wide; the exact vendored/build classification belongs to the checker's own exclusion list, not to this rule), the design system's own files, and the profile's static markup file kinds (suffix.markup).
Disposition strict, severity 2: every finding fails.

values: markup-bearing application source (component source, or markup embedded in string literals) outside a design-system root, which must exist in the repository
a raw interactive control added or already present in that code

fires: A component outside the design-system root renders a raw interactive control while the repository's design-system root holds primitives.
A handler outside the design-system root returns markup embedded in a string literal that contains a raw interactive control.
String-embedded markup anywhere in application source contains a raw interactive control, in any phase (including REFACTOR or review of existing code).
doesNotFire: The repository has no design-system root.
A primitive inside the design-system root renders the raw control.
A test file or a vendored/build tree contains raw controls.
A static markup file of the profile's markup file kinds (suffix.markup) contains a raw interactive control.
Markup-like text in code position (a comparison, a type assertion), a comment, or a regex literal mentions a control name.

The design-system root whose primitives application code must compose; its absence self-scopes the rule off.
profileRequirements.bunValue: a directory named `design`, `design_system`, or `design-system` (globs **/design/**, **/design_system/**, **/design-system/**); the first directory beneath it names the layer: `tokens` or `foundations`, `primitives`, `components`, `templates`

profileRequirements.meaning: The raw interactive control constructs of the stack's markup that application code must render through design-system primitives.
profileRequirements.bunValue: a lowercase `<button`, `<input`, `<select`, or `<textarea` element written in app code — in JSX, or in the body of a string/template/tagged-template literal in a `.ts`/`.mts` file — followed by whitespace, `>`, or `/`

proposedKeys.meaning: Root of the repository's design system (where primitives live); application code outside it must compose its primitives, and a repository without it is not judged.
proposedKeys.bunValue: a directory named `design`, `design_system`, or `design-system` (globs **/design/**, **/design_system/**, **/design-system/**); the first directory beneath it names the layer: `tokens` or `foundations`, `primitives`, `components`, `templates`
proposedKeys.whyNoExistingKey: No roots.* key names the design-system tree, and the closed role-parameter list has no design-system role, so roles.<role>.path cannot express it.

proposedKeys.meaning: The stack's raw interactive control constructs that application markup must render through design-system primitives.
proposedKeys.bunValue: a lowercase `<button`, `<input`, `<select`, or `<textarea` element written in app code — in JSX, or in the body of a string/template/tagged-template literal in a `.ts`/`.mts` file — followed by whitespace, `>`, or `/`
proposedKeys.whyNoExistingKey: idiom.markup_kinds identifies which artifacts are markup, but no idiom key lists the constructs that count as interactive controls; that set is stack-specific (web form controls in this realization).

neutralityNotes: The obligation itself (compose design-system primitives for interactive controls) is fully stack-neutral; only its data is stack-specific. The excluded markup artifact set is closed and profile-bound (suffix.markup kinds outside the judged idiom.markup_kinds), so an otherwise in-scope artifact cannot become exempt by merely being unable to consume components; the Bun instance of that set is plain .html templates. The vendored/build exclusion is not per-rule profile data: it defers to the checker's own stack-wide never-scanned list, and that deference is kept in core:verification. Two pieces of data had no closed vocabulary key and are proposed: roots.design (where the design system lives) and idiom.interactive_controls (which constructs count as raw interactive controls). Kept in the realization (bunOnly): the htmx/Bun string-embedding shape, the htmx attribute idiom, the language fact, and this rule's detector/finding ids (bun_design_system_detector, raw_control). 'During GREEN', 'REFACTOR', and 'acceptance' are ATDD process terms and stay in the core.
